## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

What detection engineering or lab testing problem does this address? Why does the current tooling fall short?

```bash

```

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about or tried?

## Additional context

Links to relevant threat intel, detection rules, or protocol specs if applicable.
